WITH filtered_item AS (
    SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
    FROM item
    WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
),
filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
)
SELECT dd.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg 
FROM filtered_date_dim dd
JOIN store_sales ss ON dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
JOIN filtered_item item ON ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
GROUP BY dd.d_year, item.i_brand_id, item.i_brand 
ORDER BY dd.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id 
LIMIT 100
